evaluation.selection: first six seconds of every preselected reference; preserve failures; no outcome-based selection

limitations: One training seed; demonstration footage, not a superiority study.
Squatting clip is a crouch hold, not repeated squat repetitions.
Training shared pool uses reference-phase initialization.
source_plan.training_dr: standard fixed lambda=1 six-channel DR versus off lambda=0; matched reset noise
source_plan.convergence: 4000 iterations is a budget, not assumed convergence

provenance.processing: mj_forward only; no stepping, fitting or generated trajectories. World XYZ in metres; qpos has XYZ, WXYZ quaternion, 29 joints in radians. Reference synchronized at k+1 per capture script. JSON rounded to 6 decimals. Envelopes: projected convex hull of each visual link mesh, in units of 1e-4 m, pelvis XY aligned; exact per-frame transforms. Projection u=.60X-.80Y, v=Z+.10(.80X+.60Y).
provenance.envelope_simplification: Douglas–Peucker within 0.0025 m projected distance; quantized at 0.0001 m. Skeleton and joint samples unchanged.
provenance.source_plan_usage: Upstream metadata snapshot retained without alteration for audit. Its method labels conflict with the author-confirmed identity of the supplied comparison bundle. It does not determine presentation policy labels; see policy_identity.

policy_identity.verification_scope: Panel and track identities are from the supplied bundle and author confirmation. This is not an independent checkpoint or training-log audit.
policy_identity.raw_key_note: fixed and off are preserved raw capture keys for traceability; presentation labels use the explicit author-confirmed mapping above.
